class.name: KfAnimator
class.brief_description: Plays Gamebryo KF clips on a [Skeleton3D] in slots, resolving each bone by the clips' controlled block priorities.
class.description: Plays several KF clips (NifServer [Animation]s, whose track paths are bone names and whose [code]nif_track_priorities[/code] metadata gives each track's controlled block priority) on the skeleton at [member skeleton_path]. Each slot, an animation group section number chosen by the caller, plays at most one clip, plus the clips it is fading out from. For each bone channel (position, rotation, scale) the tracks that key it are taken highest priority first: a priority's tracks share the weight still unclaimed, and what is left passes to the next priority down. Weight no priority claims is shared among them in proportion, so a clip fading out alone holds its pose. Bones no clip keys, and bones in [member disabled_bones], are not written. Poses are written with [method Skeleton3D.set_bone_pose_position] and its siblings, not as a [SkeletonModifier3D], so the skeleton's modifiers ([LookAtModifier3D], IK) apply on top of the written pose. Clocks, fades and text keys advance every frame; poses are written every [member update_interval] frames. [signal clip_finished] and [signal text_key] are emitted once every slot has advanced, so a handler may play or stop clips. Every start in a slot, played or [method announce]d, has a serial and emits [signal clip_started]; [method stop] and [method stop_all] emit [signal clip_stopped]. A clip played with a [code]source_serial[/code] follows the clip of that serial in the same slot of [member sync_source]. See [code]native/src/animation/README.md[/code].

method.name: announce
method.description: Records a start of the KF at [param path] in [param slot] that this animator does not play (its clip, [param animation], keys none of the skeleton's bones, or did not load and is [code]null[/code]), and emits [signal clip_started] for it, so a follower can play it. The slot's current clip fades out over [param fade_seconds] and the slot is left empty. Returns the start's serial.

method.name: consume_root_motion
method.description: Returns the root clips' motion, in the skeleton's space, added up at each pose write since the last call, and resets it. A root clip that ends or is replaced between calls has its motion up to then included. Clips in [member root_motion_excluded_slot] are left out.

method.name: get_animation
method.description: Returns the slot's current clip, or [code]null[/code] when it plays none.

method.name: get_root_clip_serial
method.description: Returns the serial of the clip [method get_root_motion] is measured from, or [code]0[/code] for none. A new value means a new clip, from whose start the motion restarts.

method.name: get_root_clip_slot
method.description: Returns the slot of the clip [method get_root_motion] is measured from, or [code]-1[/code] for none.

method.name: get_root_motion
method.description: Returns the root clip's root change since it started, in the skeleton's space; identity with no root clip or [constant ROOT_MOTION_NONE]. The root clip is the most recently started clip played with [code]keep_root[/code] outside [member root_motion_excluded_slot]. Updated when the pose is written.

method.name: get_slots
method.description: Returns the slots playing a clip.

method.name: get_start
method.description: Returns the slot's latest start, played or announced, as [code]{path, animation, serial, keep_root, speed, played}[/code], where [code]played[/code] is [code]false[/code] for an announced start. Empty when the slot has none (never started, or stopped).

method.name: get_started_slots
method.description: Returns the slots with a start, played or announced.

method.name: get_time
method.description: Returns the slot's current clip time in seconds, or [code]0[/code] when it plays none.

method.name: play
method.description: Starts [param animation] in [param slot]. It fades in over [param fade_seconds], in an empty slot too, while the slot's current clip fades out. The [code]Bip01[/code] and [code]Bip01 NonAccum[/code] tracks play only with [param keep_root]. [param path] is the clip's KF path, reported by [signal clip_started]. A non-zero [param source_serial] makes the clip follow the [member sync_source] clip of that serial in the same slot. Returns the start's serial, or [code]0[/code] when [param animation] is [code]null[/code] or keys none of the skeleton's bones; then nothing starts and nothing is emitted.

method.name: seek
method.description: Moves the slot's current clip to [param time] seconds, clamped to its length, and clears its finished state.

method.name: set_loop_section
method.description: Loops the slot's current clip between [param start] and [param end] seconds (its [code]StartLoop[/code] and [code]EndLoop[/code] text keys) [param count] times in all, then lets it play on to its end. A negative [param count] loops forever; a negative [param end] clears the section.

method.name: stop
method.description: Fades the slot's clip out over [param fade_seconds]; the slot is then empty. Emits [signal clip_stopped] when the slot had a start.

method.name: stop_all
method.description: Empties every slot at once, without fades, and emits [signal clip_stopped] for each slot that had a start.

method.name: update_pose
method.description: Writes the pose now, whatever [member update_interval].

members.member: Bone names this animator never writes, whatever keys them: they keep the pose they have. Takes effect at the next pose write.
With a root clip that keys no [code]Bip01[/code], draws [code]Bip01[/code] at the clip's origin, unrotated, rather than leaving it where it was.
Stops clip clocks, fades and text keys from advancing. Poses are still written, so [method seek] shows its frame.

A slot whose clips are never the root clip and are left out of [method consume_root_motion] (locomotion, which the controller moves), or [code]-1[/code] for none. Its clips are still drawn without their root motion when played with [code]keep_root[/code].
Which part of a [code]keep_root[/code] clip's root bones is taken out of the drawn pose and reported as root motion. See [enum RootMotionMode].

The node whose [Node3D] descendants, and itself, are the targets when [member skeleton_path] resolves to no [Skeleton3D] (a weapon's parts). A track binds to the node named as its path (the escaped NIF name). Transform tracks resolve by priority as bone channels do; a [code]<name>:visible[/code] track sets [member Node3D.visible] from the highest priority clip keying it, the newest at a tie. [code]Bip01[/code] and [code]Bip01 NonAccum[/code] tracks are skipped and no root motion is measured. A clip keying none of the nodes still plays: it keeps its clock and events, and a follower can follow it.
The [Skeleton3D] the clips play on. Clips bind to its bones by name when they are played.

Slot number to the [KfAnimator] (a [NodePath]) that clips played with a [code]source_serial[/code] in that slot follow, in place of [member sync_source]. An actor's weapon slot follows the weapon's animator while its other slots follow [member sync_source], or nothing.

The [KfAnimator] that clips played with a [code]source_serial[/code] follow. A following clip takes the source clip's time, loop section and end each frame and emits no [signal text_key] or [signal clip_finished]; while the source has no clip of that serial it runs on its own clock and emits them. The follower reads the source's time as it stands when the follower processes, so give it a higher [member Node.process_priority] than the source.
How clips at the same priority on a bone channel share it. See [enum TieMode].
Frames between pose writes, at least 1. Clocks still advance every frame, so a skipped frame only delays the pose.

signal.name: clip_finished
signal.description: Emitted when a once-only clip (no loop mode, its loop section used up) reaches its end in [param slot]. The clip then holds its last frame until it is stopped or replaced.

signal.name: clip_started
signal.description: Emitted for every start in [param slot], by [method play] or [method announce], with the start's KF [param path], its [param animation] (may be [code]null[/code] for an announced start) and its [param serial]. Emitted after the start is recorded, so [method get_start] already returns it.

signal.name: clip_stopped
signal.description: Emitted when [method stop] or [method stop_all] ends a slot that had a start.

signal.name: text_key
signal.description: Emitted when the current clip in [param slot] passes one of its text keys (NifServer's [code]nif_text_keys[/code]), with the key's text and its time in the clip, in seconds.

constants.constant: Clips at the same priority blend by their fade weights.
Only the most recently started clip at a priority counts.
Nothing is taken; root tracks are drawn as keyed.
[code]Bip01[/code]'s translation and [code]Bip01 NonAccum[/code]'s yaw about Z are taken.
[code]Bip01 NonAccum[/code]'s translation in the XY plane and its yaw about Z are taken.

The root as one transform, [code]Bip01[/code]'s translation then [code]Bip01 NonAccum[/code]'s facing measured against the stance yaw (90 degrees), its change since the clip started composed as a transform. The clip is drawn with all of it taken out: [code]Bip01[/code] at the origin, unrotated, and [code]NonAccum[/code] turned to the stance. A tested guess: the one reading that plays Doc Mitchell's chair enter, seated loop and exit correctly; not checked against the original game. Used by ActorAnimator.
